light:
Use case: style-transfer. Edit target: the user's square aerial photograph of the Lake Michigan shoreline.
Create the LIGHT version of a completely abstract, entirely glass premium desktop wallpaper for Sequoia Eleven, codename Michigan. Use the supplied photograph as a structural sketch: the curving shoreline is the major flowing S-curve, the scalloped beaches become repeated soft curved contours, the buildings become a rhythm of simplified vertical planes and stepped silhouettes along the left, and their long water shadows become broad translucent tapered streaks. Transform EVERY part of the scene into colored optical glass, frosted crystal, soft gradients and elegant flowing patterns. Do not retain any photographic pixels or realistic city objects. NO literal buildings, windows, trees, cars, roads, beach sand, ocean ripples, or photograph visible underneath. The whole image is an abstract glass sculpture of the source scene, not glass ribbons superimposed on a photo. The original geographical curve and rhythm should still be subtly recognizable in the abstract composition.
Visual direction: the sophisticated landscape abstraction of a macOS system wallpaper, with sweeping simplified layered color fields; a beautifully rendered continuous glass landscape with convincing refraction, internal glow, satin frosted areas, soft sculpted polished edges. Five or six broad flowing surfaces, restrained architectural vertical rhythm on far left, broad tranquil lake-like glass fields to right. Avoid busy tiny facets, shards, generic rainbow bubbles or a literal miniature glass city. Fine silky etched lines or subtle fluting can follow a few contours, but main surfaces are clean and spacious.
LIGHT palette: luminous turquoise and pale aqua lake forms, opalescent mint, pearlescent ivory highlights, lavender and periwinkle inner refractions with small peach/rose bands. Rich luminous gradients with enough midtone color, not washed out white. Gentle shadows, exquisite optical depth. Calm desktop negative space toward right. Entire frame is material and gradient, edge to edge, no horizon or sky. Original composition, no Apple logo or copied existing wallpaper.
Format: very wide horizontal 43:18, target 3440x1440 at highest available resolution. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, borders, monitor or mockup.
